name: War Inc: Rising Tier List 2026 — Community Rankings from Top Players
title: War Inc: Rising Tier List 2026 — All Heroes Ranked S+ to F by Top Players
meta_description: The definitive War Inc: Rising tier list based on community consensus from top-ranking players. Complete rankings of all mythics, legendaries, epics, rares, and commons with detailed explanations.
author: War Inc Wiki Team

sections.heading: S+ Tier — Game-Breaking (Must-Have)
sections.content: These troops define the current meta. If you don't have them, they should be your top priority from Wheel and Card Master events. Radiant Warrior — best mythic in the game, stacks 2-4 in every formation, level 6 gives +20% elemental resistance to all allies. Frost Queen — S+ control mage, keep two copies and never merge your last pair. Bone Marksman — pseudo level-6 at level 4 (skill unlocks earlier than normal), 250% damage Bone Shot every 8 seconds, 32K HP/2K ATK at level 4. Mistral Archer — best backline damage dealer. Goddess of War — essential support, shields nearby troops, required to protect Necromancer skeletons and Oracles from AoE. Light Seeker (Pretty Boy) — Holy Wash heals to 100% when below 50% HP, Light Volley at level 4 adds 50% attack buff, PvP destroyer. Necromancer — PvE king, deals up to 3.6M damage per dragon hit, requires Goddess of War shielding.

sections.heading: S Tier — Excellent (Top Priority)
sections.content: Oracles — pound-for-pound best epic, each gives 4% attack buff stacking up to 20 layers. 9 Oracles = 36% buff, 18 = 72%. Level 7 gives large skill range which is critical. Ursa — best legendary to upgrade to level 7. Elven Archer — best legendary range to upgrade to level 7. Darkmoon Queen — strong mythic, but one tier below Frost Queen. Ripple Wizard — Aqua Revival grants energy every 2.5 seconds, best energy battery in the game. Flame Mage — top single-target damage for hunting and Infinite War. Bomber — suicide unit dealing 3x base ATK, at level 7 stuns on death. Jungle Ranger — excellent in multiple modes. Starlight Apostle — strong mythic for summon events. Poison Master — carries early-mid Infinite War (8-10 at level 6).

sections.heading: A Tier — Strong (Worth Investing)
sections.content: Forest Scout — best rare range investment, 2.5 tile radius at level 7. Flayer Warden — best rare melee. Goblin Shredder (Chef) — single unit with splash and 2s stun (longer than Griffin Rider at 1s and Ursa at 0.5s). Shove Boy — rushdown unit. Flame Duelist — solid filler fighter. Rock Throwers — S tier in Infinite War (8 troops = 8 targets). Red Blade — jumps onto same target as Barbarian, combo with Goddess of War. Barbarian — jumps onto same target as Red Blade. Bone Gunner — good for forge stone investment. Royal Archer — buy from Exchange Shop for 4,000 coins. Paladin — shield every 10s, combos with Radiant Warrior (Radiant shield at 0s, Paladin at 10s = 2s overlap). Bomber — suicide unit good in backstab/outflank strategies.

sections.heading: B Tier — Situational (Niche Use)
sections.content: Woodland Guardian — self-heals every 12s (30% HP + 3,000 fixed), low HP/ATK offset by healing. Night King — occasional use. Iron Bulwark — new unit, on-death single-target damage prioritizing supports. Venom Spore — niche use. Melody Weaver — situational support. Frost Skeleton — on death deals area damage + speed reduction, synergizes with Bone Marksman/Bone Gunner/Bone Warden/Iron Bulwark. Apprentice Mage — only if you have nothing better. Goblin Shaman — skip unless desperate. Berserker — 8 individuals, but Falls off late-game. Werewolf — pass.

sections.heading: C/D/F Tier — Avoid
sections.content: Fury Cannoneer — unanimous F tier, do not touch (though level 6 Fury is still better than Blast Dwarf). Blast Dwarf — worse than Fury, below F tier. Wood Shield Guard — single-unit common, completely useless. Snowball Thrower — outclassed by Archer and Gunner. Gunner — outclassed by Archer. Demoman — skip. Commons worth using: Swordsman (multi-unit splash melee) and Archer (best common range, highest ATK).

sections.heading: Mythic Priority Ranking (June 2026)
sections.content: Ranked by community consensus for how to spend your Wheel and Card Master pulls: 1. Radiant Warrior (min 3 for new / 4+ for mid-game). 2. Bone Marksman (min 2 new / 4 mid — skill at level 4 is insane value). 3. Necromancer (min 3 new / 4+ mid — PvE king). 4. Woodland Guardian (min 3 new / 4+ mid). 5. Light Seeker (pass if you can't get to level 4). 6. Frost Queen (min 3 new / 4+ mid). 7. Mist Archer (min 4 new / 4+ mid). 8. Darkmoon Queen (mid-level only). 9. Red Blade (min 2 new / pass mid+).

sections.heading: Infinite War Tier List
sections.content: S: Rock Throwers (8 troops = 8 targets), Goddess of War, Poison Master. A: Flame Mages, Royal Archers, Forest Scouts, Oracles. B: Warlocks, Marksmans, high-level Mists, Storm Maidens, Jungle Rangers. 8-10 level 6 Poison Masters will carry you through early-mid Infinite War.

sections.heading: Hunting Tier List
sections.content: S: Single-target damage dealers (Flame Mages, Royal Archers). A: Forest Scouts, Bombs, Oracles. B: Buffers, tanks.

sections.heading: Rare Troop Rankings (Forge Stone Investment)
sections.content: Worth forge stones: Forest Scout (best rare), Flayer Warden (best rare melee), Goblin Shredder (2s stun is best in class), Paladin (shield overlap with Radiant Warrior), Bomber (level 7 stun on death), Frost Skeleton (speed reduction synergy). Skip: Apprentice Mage, Goblin Shaman, Berserker, Werewolf.

sections.heading: Common Troop Guide
sections.content: Best melee: Swordsman (multi-unit splash). Best range: Archer (highest ATK, multi-target). Both are worth using early. Upgrade one of each Common to level 7 for the 100-gem Power Stance achievement, then stop — forge stones are better spent elsewhere. Never use Wood Shield Guard (single unit, useless), Snowball Thrower, or Gunner.
